questions.text: Under BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, what clear space is required in front of accessible public telephones?

options.text: 1800 mm by 1800 mm clear unobstructed space
1500 mm by 1500 mm clear unobstructed space
900 mm by 1200 mm clear floor space
750 mm by 1200 mm approach space

questions.rationale: Correct answer: 1800 mm by 1800 mm clear unobstructed space. This is directly supported by BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, Public Telephones.

questions.text: Which public telephone controls or features must be within the maximum 1200 mm finished-floor height?

options.text: Dialing controls, coin slots, receivers, and instructional signs
Only the receiver and handset cord
Only emergency call buttons
Only visual signage above the phone

questions.rationale: Correct answer: Dialing controls, coin slots, receivers, and instructional signs. This is directly supported by BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, Public Telephones.
questions.explanation: This question tests the specific 200 lux telephone area illumination requirement — a factual recall item that is easy to miss.

questions.text: For public telephones, what minimum illumination is required beside the telephone?

options.text: 200 lux
50 lux
100 lux
500 lux

questions.rationale: Correct answer: 200 lux. This is directly supported by BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, Public Telephones.
questions.explanation: This question tests three simultaneous bench specifications — seat height, length, and the back support gap — all from the same section.

questions.text: Where an establishment provides public telephones, which accessible-phone distribution rule applies?

options.text: One for each floor and one for every group of two or more phones
One only at the main lobby
One for every ten phones only
One only where a security desk is present

questions.rationale: Correct answer: One for each floor and one for every group of two or more phones. This is directly supported by BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, Public Telephones.
questions.explanation: This question combines two bench specifications — the 30 m spacing interval and the 113 kg load capacity — tested together to require simultaneous recall.

questions.text: Under BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, what clear space is required in front of ATMs?

options.text: 1800 mm by 1800 mm minimum clear unobstructed space
1500 mm by 1500 mm maximum clear space
900 mm by 1200 mm transfer space only
1200 mm by 1200 mm turning space

questions.rationale: Correct answer: 1800 mm by 1800 mm minimum clear unobstructed space. This is directly supported by BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, ATMs, Kiosks and Ticket Machines.
questions.explanation: This evaluation question tests the '1,800 × 1,800 mm Club' — the three fixtures (fountain, ATM, telephone) that all require the same clear floor space — vs. the ticket counter's 1,500 × 1,500 mm.

questions.text: Which output/access modes does BP 344 list for accessible ATM, kiosk, and ticket-machine information?

options.text: Braille, tactile, and audio through speakers or earphone jacks
Visual signage only
Printed receipts only
Touchscreen gestures only

questions.rationale: Correct answer: Braille, tactile, and audio through speakers or earphone jacks. This is directly supported by BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, ATMs, Kiosks and Ticket Machines.
questions.explanation: This question tests knowledge of the 40 mm coat hook projection limit and the safety rationale behind it — important because the 'why' often appears in LEA explanations.

questions.text: What height range does BP 344 give for ATM controls, buttons, bill dispensers, and card slots?

options.text: 900 mm to 1200 mm
750 mm to 900 mm
1000 mm to 1400 mm
650 mm to 1100 mm

questions.rationale: Correct answer: 900 mm to 1200 mm. This is directly supported by BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, ATMs, Kiosks and Ticket Machines.
questions.explanation: This question tests the dual access requirement — the most common trap for drinking fountain compliance, where a correctly-sized single unit still fails.

questions.text: For dressing areas, what BP 344 coat-hook projection limit must be observed?

options.text: Not more than 40 mm from the wall
Not more than 100 mm from the wall
At least 200 mm from the wall
No projection limit is stated

questions.rationale: Correct answer: Not more than 40 mm from the wall. This is directly supported by BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, Dressing Rooms and Cubicles.
questions.explanation: This application question tests the '1 per floor + 1 per group' phone rule with a two-bank scenario.

questions.text: For drinking fountains, what spout-height range does BP 344 require?

options.text: 750 mm to 900 mm above the floor
450 mm to 600 mm above the floor
900 mm to 1200 mm above the floor
1200 mm to 1500 mm above the floor

questions.rationale: Correct answer: 750 mm to 900 mm above the floor. This is directly supported by BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, Drinking Water Facilities.
questions.explanation: This question tests the three mandatory ATM accessibility modes from Sec. 12.2 — Braille, tactile keypad, and audio — and distinguishes them from related but incorrect options.

questions.text: What knee clearance is required under an accessible drinking fountain?

options.text: 750 mm wide, 200 mm deep, and 650 mm high
900 mm wide, 300 mm deep, and 750 mm high
600 mm wide, 150 mm deep, and 450 mm high
1200 mm wide, 450 mm deep, and 900 mm high

questions.rationale: Correct answer: 750 mm wide, 200 mm deep, and 650 mm high. This is directly supported by BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, Drinking Water Facilities.
questions.explanation: This application question tests the ATM control range (900–1,200 mm) and the specific upper-limit trap — a control slightly above 1,200 mm fails even though it may look acceptable.

questions.text: For exercise equipment and machines, what accessible clear floor space does BP 344 require for at least one of each type?

options.text: 900 mm by 1200 mm served by an accessible route
1800 mm by 1800 mm in front of every machine
750 mm by 750 mm beside every machine
No machine clear space is required

questions.rationale: Correct answer: 900 mm by 1200 mm served by an accessible route. This is directly supported by BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, Exercise Equipment and Machines.
questions.explanation: This question requires precise recall of three distinct dimensions — width, depth, and height — for the drinking fountain knee clearance, and distinguishing them from ATM counter knee space.
